A cell is (pattern, timeframe, bracket). scripts/retired_ledger.py check refuses any bots file that redeploys a retired cell unchanged. Append; never delete. refuted_designs.design: hiwin33 inverted bracket (tp 0.5 / sl 1.5 ATR) as a 70%-win-rate strategy
refuted_designs.evidence: hw33 fleet: 10,291 closed 5m trades across bb_break/cci_mom/mom_adx/sma_cross/macd_rsi/macd_cross = 53-55% win, PF 0.55-0.64, net -$260. The 68-72% win rate that justified the tier came from the backtest runner resolving a candle that spans both bracket levels as a take-profit (TP checked on the favourable extreme before SL on the adverse one). The sim checks the CLOSE only and fills at the close, so realized TP is ~2x the bracket (32 vs 15 bps) and realized SL ~1.4x (60 vs 45 bps): realized R/R 0.57, break-even win ~64%, actual 54%. algo_search --intrabar close reproduces the live numbers (bb_break 50.5%, R/R 0.58). Under EVERY fill model the bracket is -EV: tp_first -$0.012/trade, sl_first -$0.013, close -$0.014.
refuted_designs.rule: Any bracket whose TP is under ~1 typical candle range must be validated with --intrabar close (sim parity) AND --intrabar sl_first (worst case). A win rate that only exists under tp_first is a fill artifact, not a property of the entry.

refuted_designs.design: indicator-conditioned entry filters on the hw33 fleet (ADX, RSI, volume_ratio, bb_width buckets)
refuted_designs.evidence: Live win rate is flat 49-58% across every bucket of every stored indicator; none separates winners from losers. Only ATR-in-bps of price is monotone (cost-floor mechanism) and it is under cross-era test as --atr-floor-bps.
refuted_designs.rule: Do not spend another iteration on oscillator/trend-strength gates for the 5m bracket family.
